paper.title_en: Probing the structure of the two proton Borromean nucleus $^{17}\rm{Ne}$ through inclusive breakup data
paper.abstract_en: The proton-rich nucleus $^{17}$Ne exhibits a Borromean structure, $^{15}$O+p+p, since both $^{16}$F and diproton systems are unbound. The low-energy spectrum of this nucleus consists of a series of resonances that remain poorly identified. In this work, a three-body model is used to describe the structure of $^{17}$Ne, with special attention to the emergence of resonant states. The four-body continuum-discretized coupled-channel (CDCC) formalism is used to study the reaction of $^{17}$Ne on a $^{208}$Pb target near the Coulomb barrier. Comparing the calculated elastic and breakup cross sections with the recently available experimental data~\cite{OVEJAS2023138007} provides an excellent framework for probing the resonant structure of this nucleus.
